verdict: UNDERPOWERED NULL. CI [-0.200,0.422] spans 0 and includes moderate effects; |rho|>=0.436 needed for 80% power at n=39. Cannot distinguish no-effect from a real moderate effect. Matches (does not independently reinforce) the GSE165897 audit power problem. FGA is also an inferior proxy: it pools HRD-driven and non-HRD-driven (FBI) genomic instability into one number.
